verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a REST API for creating workflows, managing event sources, and subscriptions, plus a CLI for deploying/developing components from local code, and Connect/MCP APIs with SDKs for auth and tool calls — showing broad programmatic access mirroring UI capabilities. However, there's no explicit confirmation that all UI-only features (e.g., visual workflow builder specifics, admin/billing dashboards) have full API parity, and no independent verification of complete equivalence. Missing for 10: explicit API/CLI docs confirming full parity for every UI action (e.g., visual step editing, team management), independent hands-on confirmation that API-only workflows match UI-built ones exactly.
